summary.prose: Building S004 is almost entirely plugin-side work: one field already projected by the daemon and already arriving at the extension host is carried the last hop onto the webview message, and a fifth source string is added to the single nonce'd script that renders a reviewer's document. That string holds a recursive walk over the eight-member Adaptive-Cards union, mirroring the daemon's corrected renderUxMockDocument in structure and class vocabulary while refusing its method — the daemon emits HTML strings, the webview builds the same tree with createElement and textContent, which is what keeps the mock a drawing of a record rather than a path to the network. The hard part is not the code, it is proving the result LOOKS like an interface: every DOM stub is CSS-blind, so the renderer is read as screenshots in both themes before it is wired, a structural (tag, class, child-order) diff pins the client against the daemon over shared fixtures, and nine mutations each have to turn a named test red. The surface change itself is deliberately one call at the end — mounting the experience slot beside S003's diagram slot — so the whole Story reverts to the shipped surface by removing it.

tasks.summary: Add the FIFTH member of the DOCS_*_SOURCE family and inline it into the single nonce'd script after its four siblings. The sc4 slot factory moved to t5 — a different seam, and the Story's one novel piece should not review alongside its most boilerplate piece. Structure and the `ux-*` class vocabulary MIRROR renderUxMockDocument; its METHOD is refused — the daemon emits HTML strings, so the same tree is built with createElement and textContent. tasks.summary: Render each of the FOUR real ledger uxDefinitions with the renderer alone, screenshot headless, and READ the images. Deliberately its own task and deliberately early — before the slot factory and before the mount: the Story's central risk is a card with every element present and every assertion green that does not look like an interface, precisely the defect this Epic already shipped and corrected, which no assertion caught then either. Catching a layout failure here costs one task instead of three. Two additions from the critique: read in a LIGHT theme as well as dark, because t2's colour scan proves only that variables were used and not that the result is legible; and write the nesting measurement to a NAMED FILE, because t4 must cite evidence that exists rather than my recollection of an image.
